name: Fear No Evil
creator: Fantasy Flight Games
description:
A wave of crime is washing over New York City and the public blames its heroes for it. Fear No Evil combines five interchangeable main schemes with five interchangeable UNDERLING villains — Bullseye, Electro, Hammerhead, Purple Man and Typhoid Mary — before a final showdown against the Kingpin.

Unlike other Marvel Champions campaigns the order is not fixed: before each game two unresolved scenarios progress on their own, and the players then choose which one to tackle. A scenario that progresses three times Fails and its environment penalises the rest of the campaign; a scenario that is won leaves a benefit in play instead. Once all five main schemes are Completed or Failed, Kingpin awaits.
epilogue:
The Kingpin falls.
With Wilson Fisk brought down, the manufactured crime wave collapses with him. The city sees who was really pulling the strings, and Hell's Kitchen exhales — until the next night falls.

trackers: Allies et Soutiens retires de la campagne (Allies and Persona Supports Removed from the Campaign)

narrative.title: Scenario #1 - Protection Racket
narrative.description: Goons are shaking down a mom-and-pop shop for protection money. Each player defends their own storefront: in this scenario every player has their own main scheme, and effects outside a play area apply to all of them at once.
narrative.introduction:
Encounter deck: Protection Racket, Disasters, Tracksuit Mafia, Standard, and the chosen underling villain's set.
  • Each player chooses a single Protection Racket main scheme (at random in expert mode) and places it in their play area on its 1B side. Set the unused main schemes aside.
  • Campaign setup: place 1 threat (2 in expert mode) on each main scheme for each check mark beside « Protection Racket » in the campaign log.
  • Gather the five campaign environments (60205–60209) and remove each one matching a Completed or Failed scenario. Shuffle the rest and draw two at random (draw the last one if only one remains).
  • Progress each scenario matching a drawn environment by marking its first unmarked box. If only one environment was drawn, mark two boxes. Three marks = that scenario has Failed.
  • Choose any scenario that is neither Completed nor Failed. Once all five are resolved, the players must take on Kingpin.
  • Determine the underling villain: keep the one already recorded for this scenario; otherwise on a first playthrough take the first unused villain in the recommended order (Hammerhead, Bullseye, Electro, then Purple Man or Typhoid Mary), or pick one at random on later playthroughs.
  • Remove from every deck each card recorded under « Allies/Supports removed from the campaign », then rebuild each deck up to its minimum size.
  • Expert Campaign Only: set each player's hit points to the value recorded after the previous scenario, then each player may deal themself one facedown encounter card to heal damage equal to its REC.
  • Put each Completed or Failed environment into play on its matching side and resolve its « Setup » ability.
  • If « Trust Established? » is checked and « Mary Defeated? » is not, put the Typhoid Mary campaign ally (60210A) into play under any player's control.
narrative.resolution:
Victory:
  • If Disturbed Psyche (60112) is in play with at least 2 threat on it, check « Trust Established? » in the campaign log.
  • If the Typhoid Mary/Bloody Mary ally (60210) is in the victory display, check « Mary Defeated? ».
  • Record the title of each unique ally and persona support removed from the game.
  • Check the « Completed » box for this scenario, then go back to Campaign Setup.
narrative.epilogue:
Defeat:
  • Go back to Campaign Setup.
  • Expert Campaign Only: progress « Protection Racket » in the campaign log.

narrative.title: Scenario #6 - Kingpin
narrative.description: The crime wave was manufactured, and the public blames the heroes for it. Kingpin stays untouchable behind the scenes until the heroes rebuild enough public support to reach him.
narrative.introduction:
Villain deck: Kingpin (A1) — replace with Kingpin (B1) in expert mode. Main scheme deck: The King's Gambit, then Endgame. Encounter deck: Kingpin, Tombstone and Tracksuit Mafia. This scenario does not use the Standard set, but still uses the Expert set in expert mode.
  • Each player reveals their set-aside nemesis minion. A nemesis minion sharing a title with a character in play is removed from the game; that player instead finds an UNDERLING minion in the encounter deck and reveals it.
  • Kingpin cannot be damaged, stunned or confused on his « 1 » side and schemes instead of attacking. Each defeated minion places a support counter on Public Support, which eventually flips him to his « 2 » side.
  • Campaign setup: with at least 3 Completed environments in play, give each minion in play a tough status card; with at least 4, find and reveal the James Wesley attachment.
  • Gather the five campaign environments (60205–60209) and remove each one matching a Completed or Failed scenario. Shuffle the rest and draw two at random (draw the last one if only one remains).
  • Progress each scenario matching a drawn environment by marking its first unmarked box. If only one environment was drawn, mark two boxes. Three marks = that scenario has Failed.
  • Choose any scenario that is neither Completed nor Failed. Once all five are resolved, the players must take on Kingpin.
  • Determine the underling villain: keep the one already recorded for this scenario; otherwise on a first playthrough take the first unused villain in the recommended order (Hammerhead, Bullseye, Electro, then Purple Man or Typhoid Mary), or pick one at random on later playthroughs.
  • Remove from every deck each card recorded under « Allies/Supports removed from the campaign », then rebuild each deck up to its minimum size.
  • Expert Campaign Only: set each player's hit points to the value recorded after the previous scenario, then each player may deal themself one facedown encounter card to heal damage equal to its REC.
  • Put each Completed or Failed environment into play on its matching side and resolve its « Setup » ability.
  • If « Trust Established? » is checked and « Mary Defeated? » is not, put the Typhoid Mary campaign ally (60210A) into play under any player's control.
narrative.resolution:
Victory:
  • The players take down Kingpin and win the campaign!
  • Expert Campaign Only: if at least one environment is on its Completed side, choose one, flip it to its Failed side and replay the scenario. Otherwise the players lose the campaign.
